name: Warehouse Design
description: Visual and UX guidelines for the Warehouse HTML/CSS/JS prototype. Reference implementation: login page.

principles.beautiful: Clean blue-white surfaces, soft shadows, rounded corners, subtle atmospheric gradients — never flat or cluttered.
principles.easy: Obvious hierarchy, large touch targets on mobile, inline validation, visible feedback on every action.
principles.responsive: Mobile-first; layouts adapt for tablet portrait, tablet landscape, desktop, and wide desktop without stretching content.
principles.theme: Light and dark modes with paired tokens; persist user choice; default from prefers-color-scheme.
principles.i18n: Thai and English via js/i18n/ dictionaries; default th; no hardcoded single-language UI copy.
principles.a11y: Visible labels, aria-label on icon-only controls, focus rings, reserved error slots to prevent layout shift.

atmosphere.pageWash: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 15% -5%, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.1), transparent 55%) over background
atmosphere.pageWashDark: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 15% -5%, rgb(59 130 246 / 0.14), transparent 55%) over background
atmosphere.brandPanelGlow: soft circular glow bottom-right at rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08)

mobile.notes: Base styles; single column; drawer nav; large touch targets.

tabletPortrait.notes: Wider single column; cards and tables use full width; sidebar stays drawer.

tabletLandscape.notes: Limited vertical height; prefer two-column grids where helpful; reduce vertical padding; avoid tall-only layouts.

computer.notes: Sticky sidebar; increased breathing room; auth pages may use split-panel layout.

computerWide.notes: Content max-width ~1280–1440px centered; do not stretch forms or tables edge-to-edge; extra outer padding.

mobile.structure: fixed icon toolbar + centered single card

computer.brandPanel: gradient + grid overlay + soft glow; centered logo, name, tagline
computer.formColumn: flex 1; left-aligned header; no card border/shadow

adminShell.pageWash: dual radial blue gradient on .admin-layout (Stitch-modern atmosphere)

sidebar.surface: translucent panel + right shadow + blur(12px); flush-left full-height
sidebar.brand: Lucide warehouse icon in primary-tint square + app.name; hairline divider below
sidebar.search: inset muted field; min-height 2.75rem; radius 0.75rem; strong focus ring
sidebar.activeNav: primary tint + inset ring + semibold; icon well highlight
sidebar.chevron: Lucide chevron-down; rotate 180deg when group open
sidebar.footer: sticky viewport bottom — user + logout; nav scrolls above when menu overflows

header.surface: translucent panel + blur(12px) + bottom shadow — matches sidebar surface
header.breadcrumb: plain text trail — muted parent links + bold current h1; > separators
header.actions: ghost icon buttons — bell (red badge dot), language, theme (sun/moon)

typography.sidebarBrand: text-xl bold; icon in primary-tint rounded square
typography.sidebarNav: text-sm rows min-height 2.75rem; sub-items text-sm with left rail
typography.breadcrumbParent: text-sm muted gray; link hover primary
typography.breadcrumbCurrent: text-sm semibold foreground; text-base at computer

mobile.sidebar: fixed drawer; translateX(-100%); opens with backdrop

iconToolbarButton.style: glass — semi-transparent background + backdrop-filter blur(8px); login toolbar only
iconToolbarButton.sharedClass: .login-toolbar__btn — login page; admin header uses .btn.btn--icon (matches CRUD table)

structure: control wrapper (.form-field__control) with optional leading icon

formBanner.use: auth failures and server-level errors only — not empty required fields

toast.style: card with left accent border + Lucide type icon + dismiss button

sidebar.activeStyle: soft primary tint — rgb(37 99 235 / 0.1) light, rgb(59 130 246 / 0.15) dark

devBar.scope: design prototype only — never ship to frontend

emptyAndLoading.emptyLists: show empty-state message — never blank white area
emptyAndLoading.loading: disable trigger button + brief loading label
emptyAndLoading.skeleton: optional but preferred over blank flicker

navigation.mobilePrimaryActions: within thumb reach — full-width submit at bottom of forms

centeredCard.when: mobile and tablet portrait for auth and hub pages

crudList.computer: toolbar row; table in bordered card

pagination.controls: show [limit] items + total count; chevron prev/next + page number pills (max 5 visible); pagination outside table card

sort.tree: group by parent_id; sibling sort_order ASC → id ASC; DFS pre-order (tree_path for indent/query only)

dragSort.mechanism: HTML5 native draggable — no external library
dragSort.handle: grip-vertical icon column (first col); draggable on tr
dragSort.onDrop: reassign sort_order = (index+1)*10 for rows in same scope; batch store.update()
dragSort.treeConstraint: drag within same parent_id only; cross-parent drop shows warning toast
dragSort.geoConstraint: drag within same parent FK group only (sortParentKey on config)
dragSort.sortOrderField: hidden from columns and form; managed by drag only

wideDesktopContainment.rule: center content with max-width; do not scale typography or input widths with viewport

doNot: Use emoji as UI chrome or action icons
Use icon packs other than Lucide (Font Awesome, Heroicons, Material, CDN scripts)
Hardcode UI copy in a single language
Stretch forms or data tables full-width on wide desktop monitors
Show validation errors only in a form-level banner without under-field messages
Allow layout shift when validation errors appear
Mutate store data without visible feedback (toast or inline error)
Connect to real database or API from design/
Put real secrets or passwords in seed or document/

newPage: Follow script load order from SKILL.md
Use theme tokens from css/style.css — no hardcoded hex except error red
All UI copy via i18n dictionaries
Responsive at mobile, tablet portrait, tablet landscape, computer, computerWide
devBar.mount() with page-specific toasts and actions
Touch targets at least 44px on mobile
visualQA: No layout shift on validation errors
Primary actions obvious and reachable on mobile
Wide desktop does not over-stretch content
